hand_verified_reasoning: Temperature range must be wider-or-equal at both ends (the direction rule). Requirement needs -40C to 85C (with the max already carrying the >=20C margin convention, so a candidate max of 105C would clear that on its own). But the candidate's cold-end limit is -20C, which does not cover the required -40C -- a hard range shrink on the low side, independent of the margin question on the high side. Voltage (60V >= 20V) and current (1.5A >= 1A) both pass easily; the sole, deliberate defect is the narrowed operating range floor.
